title: Act: Validate execution timeout, retries, budget and provider kind in LoadFS
summary: Add validate function rejecting invalid values
description: Add a validate(cfg *Config) error helper checking execution_timeout, max_retries, max_budget and provider_kind, called at the end of LoadFS.
acceptance_criteria: Negative timeout, retries, budget and unknown provider return key-naming errors

steps.action: Add func validate(cfg *Config) error returning fmt.Errorf errors that name worker.execution_timeout (<0), worker.max_retries (<0), worker.max_budget (<0) and worker.provider_kind (not mock or claude).
Before `return &cfg, nil` call validate(&cfg) and return nil, err when it fails.
steps.expected: Invalid configs return nil config and a key-naming error.
